rules.name: Minimum edge vs. fair price
rules.note: Only bet when the blended fair price beats the offered price by this much.

rules.name: At least 2 other books price the line
rules.note: One soft book is not a market. Fair prices need at least two reference books (Pinnacle counts).

rules.name: Max bets per player per day
Max bets per day (best edges first)
Skip players with under 3 games this season
rules.note: Roles are unsettled in the first weeks. The NFL plays about 17 games, so 3 is the NBA's 8.

rules.name: Avoid bets where our projection disagrees with the market side
rules.note: If the market edge says Over but our own projection leans Under, skip.
